description: This file defines classes and constants for ASN.1 data encoding/decoding, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with functions for handling ASN.1 data structures.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Manages a byte buffer with reference counting and size management for ASN.1 encoding.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: Represents an Object Identifier with parsing and text conversion capabilities.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: Represents an ASN.1 sequence with parsing and iteration methods.

methods.name: Buffer(const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer with specified length.

methods.name: Size(const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Size() const
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.
